snippet.title: Nick.Com Wave Rave online Game Commercial (2001)
snippet.description:
Nick.Com Wave Rave online Game Commercial (2001)

The Nick.Com Wave Rave was an online multiplayer game released around 2000, hosted on the Nickelodeon website. It was described as an all-out soak-fest that allowed four players from anywhere in the world to log on and play together simultaneously. Players could choose from 10 radical characters and dive into the action, where the goal was to soak the opponents with water pistols.

It’s interesting to note that there was a re-skin of the game called Le Food Frenzy to promote the movie Rugrats in Paris, where players used food as weapons instead of water pistols. The game required Shockwave to play, which was a common multimedia platform for interactive applications and video games during that era.

The game seems to hold a nostalgic value for those who played it during their childhood, and while it’s no longer actively maintained, there’s an archived version that is mostly functional. However, playing the archived version might still require Shockwave, which has been known for security vulnerabilities.
